mapper.select: WITH people AS (), own_combos AS ( SELECT p.* FROM playlist p JOIN people u ON u.id = p.user_id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people) AS people_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE email LIKE 'beta-%@beta.asmrblock.com') AS beta_guests, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE email NOT LIKE 'beta-%@beta.asmrblock.com') AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people x WHERE = ) AS new_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS new_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL) AS combos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS combos_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL AND is_public = true) AS public_combos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NOT NULL) AS collects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log WHERE played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS plays_24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log WHERE played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS plays_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log) AS plays_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block WHERE is_active = true AND status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.uploader_id WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND u.email = 'samples@asmrblock.invalid') AS sample_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b JOIN people u ON u.id = b.uploader_id WHERE b.is_active = true) AS user_uploads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block WHERE is_active = true AND status = 'PENDING') AS pending_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE is_done = false) AS new_feedback

WITH days AS ( SELECT generate_series( - 13, , INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS d ), people AS (), signups AS (SELECT AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM people x GROUP BY 1), combos AS (SELECT AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM playlist x JOIN people u ON u.id = x.user_id WHERE x.source_playlist_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1), plays AS (SELECT ((played_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM play_log GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.d AS date, COALESCE(s.n, 0) AS signups, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS combos, COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS plays FROM days LEFT JOIN signups s ON s.d = days.d LEFT JOIN combos c ON c.d = days.d LEFT JOIN plays p ON p.d = days.d ORDER BY days.d
